name: @sure/web
//typescript: Held on 5.x with the rest of the workspace. TypeScript 7 is not a bump but a migration: `svelte-check@4.7.5` (which peers `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0`) refuses to even start on it — "TypeScript 7 support currently requires both TypeScript 7 and TypeScript 6 installed in your project, and requires using the --tsgo or --tsgo-experimental-api flag", i.e. a dual install via an npm alias. Measured 2026-08-11. The 5.x ceiling itself comes from openapi-typescript; see the note in packages/client.
//@playwright/test: Keep in lockstep with the pinned `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:vX-noble` image in .github/workflows/checks.yml — the committed *-linux.png baselines are only reproducible against the Chromium build and font stack that image ships. Currently both are 1.62.1, and `pnpm snapshots:verify`/`snapshots:update` refuse to run when they disagree (scripts/linux-snapshots.mjs compares this range against that tag). Bumping one means bumping the other and re-running `pnpm snapshots:update`.
//@types/node: For `tests/` only (tsconfig.tests.json), never for `src/` — the app has no Node globals and must not typecheck as though it did. Same range as packages/api-tests for the same reason: it tracks the Node major this repo runs (`engines.node` >=24, every workflow pins node-version 24), not npm `latest`. Raise it together with the Node pin.
